title: GI BAO as a cosmological consistency check (Chan, Li, McCullough)
efc_relevance: First density-shear (GI) BAO measurement on photometric data, using DES Y3. Constrains the BAO scale dilation parameter to 0.966 ± 0.037 and validates the density BAO, shear measurement, and linear-alignment model jointly. Provides EFC with an independent low-systematic anchor for the BAO scale at the DES Y3 effective redshift — any EFC E(z) prediction must remain consistent with this combined density+shear BAO scale, not just density-BAO alone.
ledger_action: Add to Likelihood Ledger as a cross-check probe under cluster bao_consistency; add note to existing DESI DR2 BAO row (arXiv:2503.14738) that GI BAO from DES Y3 sits at 0.966 ± 0.037 — EFC's predicted BAO dilation at z_DES_Y3 must overlap this band within 1σ; cross-reference arXiv:2601.14559 (DES Y6).
